what: The occultation without the ellipse: what five chords and 23 stations that saw nothing force on the size of (95626) 2002 GZ32 (2017 May 20, Santos-Sanz et al. 2021, arXiv:2012.06621), assuming only that the silhouette is convex. The chord-length function is concave on its support, so the floor is the concave hull of the chords and the ceiling is concavity read backwards, clipped at the nearest miss; every area is an exact rational and nothing converges.

declaredPatches.chords.js, chords.test.js, make-page-dat: one require each: ../../lib/eqcert/rational.js -> ../interval/rational.js. The same module, lifted from sin-mfg into instruments/interval/ (the port document says lib/eqcert is the labs' code and never travels). Equivalence on this data is not assumed: page.json rebuilt here is byte-identical to the pin.

rule: Copied byte-for-byte and pinned by sha256; frontier-apps has no git. The paper is a pinned artifact (TeX, figures.tex and the PDF as typeset there with tectonic); figures.tex is regenerated from page.json by paper/make-figures.js and must reproduce. Data were transcribed by hand from the paper's Table A1 and Table 5 — data/gz32-2017-05-20.csv is the transcription, data/gz32-published.json the paper's own numbers.

acceptance.node reds.js: 6 reds fire (the control is a dumbbell, which must land OUTSIDE)
acceptance.numbers: 1-sigma chord errors: Deq in [168.3, 267.5] km; published ellipse 206 +- 15 and radiometric 237 +- 8 both inside; at face value no convex silhouette (concave hull 5.5 km over Javalambre); negatives out of reach: ceiling 267.5 -> 577.0 km
